verdict.rationale: Kit documents scheduling a broadcast via the API with a `send_at` schedule, which can be updated or deleted. It also lists 'Unlimited Visual Automations' and 'RSS campaigns' on its pricing page, but none of this evidence shows recurring or cron-style scheduling of jobs or workflows. The scheduling evidence covers one-off broadcasts only, and the automation and RSS items are single-line mentions with no detail on recurrence. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedules (cron or interval) for workflows or automations, details on how RSS campaigns recur, scheduling of recurring work via the API or MCP, and independent corroboration.
